meta.title: Nishal NM · Backend Developer
meta.description: Python Backend Developer building production-grade, API-driven systems with Django, Docker, and real-time infrastructure.

profile.name: Nishal NM
profile.tagline: Building systems that run, not just code that compiles.
profile.about: I'm a backend developer from Tirurangadi, Kerala — I enjoy building things that actually hold up in production. I care about clean APIs, reliable infrastructure, and systems that solve real problems for real people.
profile.footerNote: Built with intention, not a template.

points: Led a 4-member cross-functional team (backend, Flutter, 2× frontend) delivering a production-grade coaching institution platform end-to-end.
Designed and maintained 30+ REST APIs powering student, mentor, and admin workflows across web and mobile.
Built real-time student activity monitoring via WebSockets (Django Channels) and async task pipelines with Celery + Redis.
Integrated Razorpay for premium subscriptions (Flutter app) and cubicle rental bookings (web).
Containerised all services with Docker, configured Nginx for HTTP and WebSocket routing, deployed on a dedicated server.
Automated daily DB backups via Celery — compressed SQL dumps with 7-day rolling retention.
Synced all backups and MinIO media files to Google Drive automatically using rclone.
Also rebuilt the backend of a legacy PHP CRM — separated it into a clean REST API with real-time WebSocket chat and dual-mode auth for web and mobile.
Built web applications with Python and Flask; worked with SQLite databases.
Delivered a Blog Web Application as the primary project.
Worked on Python ML workflows — data preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation.
Contributed to early research and data pipeline development for the RideLync project.

projects.name: Coaching Institution Platform
projects.description: Full institutional backend managing students, mentors, admins, and payments. Real-time activity monitoring via WebSockets, background pipelines, mobile payment integration, and live server deployment — built and led from scratch.

projects.name: Legacy CRM Backend Rebuild
projects.description: Rebuilt the backend of a legacy PHP CRM — separated a mixed codebase into a standalone REST API and an independent frontend. Added WebSocket-based real-time chat, dual-mode auth for web and mobile, and proper security fixes throughout.

projects.name: RideLync
projects.description: Route-matching system that ingests vehicle movement data from camera checkpoints. Uses YOLOv5 for vehicle detection and EasyOCR for automated license plate recognition to detect recurring travel patterns.

projects.name: Quiz Game
projects.description: Interactive timed quiz with immediate feedback, score tracking, and responsive UI across multiple topic categories.

projects.name: Fuel Calculator
projects.description: A fuel cost estimator that calculates trip expenses based on distance, mileage, and fuel price.

projects.name: Test Memory
projects.description: A card-matching memory game with smooth animations, responsive design, and clean game logic. Built to sharpen React skills.
